description: Bilingual industrial natural language instruction parser and task sequence intent classifier.

Fine-tuned lightweight multi-task FPN/ConvNet for 2D/3D industrial part detection, instance segmentation, and point-cloud lifting (bolts, wrenches, rollers, pliers, screwdrivers, parts bins, toolboxes).
Project-trained Qwen2.5-3B LoRA for fixed-schema bilingual industrial task planning. Improved using Qwen.
